_comment: Canned responses for GET /moments/{video_id}@{start}-{end}?expand=caption,frame (Memories.ai shape: {ref, caption:[{start,end,text}], frames:[{t,url}]}). Frame URLs are same-origin posters under public/evidence/frames/<video_id>/{0,3}.jpg and embed the video id so the search stub can key off the /frames/<video_id>/ segment; inspect_evidence prefers the t=3 frame. Keyed by video_id; `default` for unknown ids.
